target.statement: Assessor360 achieves SRCC of 0.9802 on the OIQA dataset (Table 1, row Assessor360, column OIQA SRCC).

compute.basis: Training a Swin Transformer base model for 300 epochs on 320 high-resolution ODIs with 15 viewports per image requires GPU acceleration; CPU-only training would take days, and the paper's 10 random splits further increase time.

blockers: Training Assessor360 from scratch requires a GPU; CPU-only training is impractical.
OIQA dataset consists of very high-resolution images (up to 13320x6660), requiring significant disk space and memory for preprocessing.
The paper reports median results over 10 random train-test splits, multiplying the training time by 10.
title: Assessor360: Multi-sequence Network for Blind Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment
